subject.title: Bug: 升级后 Dashboard 历史会话索引/映射错乱

question: What evidence may OpenClaw use to relink a Dashboard session key to a different preserved transcript or trajectory after upgrade?
rationale: The code can prove the bad mapping would be trusted, but choosing a safe repair rule affects persistent user history and could attach a key to the wrong file without maintainer-approved evidence requirements.

options.title: Diagnostic first
options.body: Add a doctor diagnostic that detects suspicious Dashboard mappings and reports candidate files without rewriting user history until fixtures prove a safe rule.

options.title: Strict doctor relink
options.body: Allow doctor --fix to relink only when transcript headers, trajectory records, store metadata, and timestamps uniquely identify one preserved candidate.

options.title: Manual recovery only
options.body: Document manual export/recovery and avoid automatic relinking for historical mappings that cannot be proven safely.

recommendation.title: Diagnostic first
recommendation.body: Add a doctor diagnostic that detects suspicious Dashboard mappings and reports candidate files without rewriting user history until fixtures prove a safe rule.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work owns the transcript reader identity and gateway session read surfaces most directly involved in deciding a safe repair boundary.
